mentions.claim_text: Opening a news-and-prayer recap, he points viewers back to the previous day's prayer video and says the Lord was showing them about the World War, without restating any content of it here.
mentions.quote: what the Lord was showing us about the World War
mentions.falsify_match: Unfalsifiable as stated: a pointer to an earlier video, naming no outcome that could be checked.
mentions.falsify_miss: Cannot fail; the passage carries no forecast of its own, only a reference to one made elsewhere.

mentions.claim_text: Witchcraft is being worked around the Pergamon altar using a satanic artifact tied to CERN, and he sees darkness over CERN with black-cloaked men around it.
mentions.quote: the Lord showed me darkness concerning CERN
mentions.falsify_match: Public reporting of an occult rite or artifact connecting the Pergamon altar to CERN, or a named ritual group operating at CERN.
mentions.falsify_miss: Mostly unfalsifiable: darkness over an institution is a spiritual reading with no public test; only the artifact-and-CERN link could be checked and found absent.

mentions.claim_text: Men in black cloaks are attempting to summon the Hitler spirit again, and he sees swastikas coming up out of Berlin.
mentions.quote: trying to summons up the Hitler spirit again
mentions.falsify_match: A visible resurgence of open Nazi symbolism organised out of Berlin, reported in mainstream sources.
mentions.falsify_miss: The summoning itself is unobservable; the claim fails only if no swastika resurgence out of Berlin is reported over the period he is describing.

mentions.claim_text: He sees a woman the Lord names Ursula rising up over Europe.
mentions.quote: the Lord called her Ursula. I saw her come up
mentions.falsify_match: The named European Commission president gaining further power or prominence over Europe.
mentions.falsify_miss: Rising over Europe is not defined; she already heads the Commission, so the base rate is near one and no outcome would clearly refute it.

mentions.claim_text: The woman named Ursula has a bright star above her head and chains running from her into each of the nations; the Lord calls her a bride of Satan connected to the devil.
mentions.quote: This woman is a bride of Satan
mentions.falsify_match: No public criterion; the star, the chains and the title are spiritual descriptions.
mentions.falsify_miss: Unfalsifiable as stated: a spiritual verdict on a person, with nothing that could come out the other way.

mentions.claim_text: Demonic worship and Satanism are being brought up through a man he names as George, alongside other wealthy cloaked figures.
mentions.quote: demonic Satanism through George, a man named George
mentions.falsify_match: Reporting tying a prominent European financier named George to occult practice.
mentions.falsify_miss: Unfalsifiable in practice: an accusation of hidden Satanism has no observable test either way.

mentions.claim_text: These figures are working to draw England, France, Germany and Italy into a great war.
mentions.quote: trying to bring England, uh France, Germany, Italy
mentions.falsify_match: All four named states entering a general European war as combatants.
mentions.falsify_miss: None of the four named states enters open war in Europe; no date is given, so the miss only registers over a long horizon.

mentions.claim_text: Turkey shuts the strait into the Black Sea while England and France try to bring battleships and major naval power in during the days ahead.
mentions.quote: England trying to bring battleships into the Black Sea
mentions.falsify_match: Turkey closing the Turkish Straits to warships while British or French naval vessels seek entry to the Black Sea.
mentions.falsify_miss: No Turkish closure and no British or French battleship movement toward the Black Sea. Base rate note: Montreux already bars most non-littoral warships and Turkey invoked it in 2022, so a closure alone would be near-routine.

mentions.claim_text: Turkey and Syria stand on Russia's side and block things, which he describes as causing a kink in the hose.
mentions.quote: Turkey and Syria were on Russia's side
mentions.falsify_match: Turkey and Syria taking Russia's side in a European confrontation, in policy or in military action.
mentions.falsify_miss: Turkey or Syria siding against Russia, or neither aligning with it, when a European confrontation comes to a head.

mentions.claim_text: He sees the American president cracking a whip against this, shown as a balloon marked with his campaign slogan.
mentions.quote: I saw Trump cracking his whip
mentions.falsify_match: The president acting publicly to restrain a European escalation over the Black Sea.
mentions.falsify_miss: Unfalsifiable as an image; whip-cracking has no threshold, and any presidential statement on Europe could be read into it.

mentions.claim_text: Praying, he sees two ways: one leading to World War III and a great war.
mentions.quote: One way went to World War III and a great war
mentions.falsify_match: A general war involving the major powers, described at the time as a world war.
mentions.falsify_miss: No general war, and the other path he names taken instead. He names both outcomes, so the pair cannot fail together.

mentions.claim_text: The second of the two ways he sees is lavender fields with Russia.
mentions.quote: the other word way was lavender fields with Russia
mentions.falsify_match: A settlement or peace with Russia, which he has repeatedly glossed lavender as meaning.
mentions.falsify_miss: War with Russia widens instead of settling. Because he names both branches in one breath, only the pair taken together is scoreable, and neither branch alone is a hit.

mentions.claim_text: The lavender fields he sees are planted and giving a season.
mentions.quote: I could see the lavender fields that were uh there planted
mentions.falsify_match: A period of settlement or reduced fighting involving Russia beginning within a season.
mentions.falsify_miss: No let-up with Russia during the season that follows. Season is left undefined here, which weakens any hit.

mentions.claim_text: The Lord tells him to watch China, which is quiet and playing chess while getting ready to do something he calls dangerous.
mentions.quote: Watch China
mentions.falsify_match: A major Chinese move taken while Europe is preoccupied, of a kind reported as having been prepared quietly.
mentions.falsify_miss: China takes no significant new action. Base rate note: an instruction to watch a great power is close to unfalsifiable, and only a named Chinese action would lift this above a truism.

mentions.claim_text: European nations under demonic influence are working through the Pergamon altar, CERN and the woman Ursula to bring about a single world-wide war.
mentions.quote: satanic things on the Pergamon altar trying to bring forth satanic
mentions.falsify_match: A general war originating in Europe, with the named European leadership driving it.
mentions.falsify_miss: No European-origin general war. The ritual element is unfalsifiable; only the war is scoreable.

mentions.claim_text: Europe is working to provoke a great war and to poke the bear, and he sees an attack coming on Poland again.
mentions.quote: I saw an attack coming on Poland again
mentions.falsify_match: A reported attack on Polish territory, whether drone, missile or ground incursion.
mentions.falsify_miss: No attack on Poland. Base rate note: Russian drones have crossed into Poland repeatedly since 2022, so a small incursion would have happened anyway and would not be a strong match.

mentions.claim_text: The Lord tells him a major earthquake is coming in Acapulco, San Francisco, Portland and those areas, and to watch the ring of fire.
mentions.quote: There's going to be a major earthquake in this and San Francisco
mentions.falsify_match: A damaging earthquake, magnitude 6 or above, at Acapulco, San Francisco or Portland.
mentions.falsify_miss: No major quake at any of the three named cities. Base rate note: small quakes near San Francisco are routine, so only a damaging event at a named city counts.

mentions.claim_text: A great disruption in Mexican politics follows once these things start, with chaos, and then a glory moving in on Mexico.
mentions.quote: you're going to see a disruption in Mexico
mentions.condition_text: when all these other things start to take place
mentions.falsify_match: Upheaval in the Mexican government reported after the European events he describes begin.
mentions.falsify_miss: Mexican politics stays stable through the period. The trigger is vague, which lets the window slide indefinitely.

mentions.claim_text: He sees a triangle running from the woman Ursula to Benjamin to Saudi Arabia, and a circuit from Europe to the Pergamon altar to Benjamin to Israel to Saudi Arabia and back to Europe, tied to bringing about the end of the end.
mentions.quote: a triangle that went from this woman to Benjamin to Saudi Arabia
mentions.falsify_match: A three-way dealing between the European Commission, the Israeli prime minister and Saudi Arabia becoming public.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such alignment forms. The end of the end framing is unfalsifiable; only the triangle is checkable.

mentions.claim_text: Confirming a recap of what he saw, he names Claudia, an overthrowing of things, civil unrest, riots in the streets and people pillaging.
mentions.quote: I see civil unrest. I see riots in the streets
mentions.falsify_match: Mass rioting and looting in Mexico alongside the removal or attempted removal of its president.
mentions.falsify_miss: No riots at that scale and the Mexican president stays in office. Base rate note: protests in Mexico City are frequent, so ordinary demonstrations would not count.

mentions.claim_text: He sees a great shaking in Canada.
mentions.quote: A great shaking in Canada. A shaking in Canada
mentions.falsify_match: A national-scale crisis in Canada, political, economic or seismic, reported as such.
mentions.falsify_miss: Unfalsifiable in practice: shaking is not defined here as quake, economy or politics, so almost any Canadian bad news could be claimed.

mentions.claim_text: He says the Lord will deal with an epidemic of cancer on the land which he attributes to the foods, that there are special anointings for cancer, and that a cure is coming for certain cancers.
mentions.quote: there's special anointings for cancer and there's a cure coming
mentions.falsify_match: A treatment reported as a cure, not merely a therapy, approved for a specific cancer.
mentions.falsify_miss: No cure announced. Base rate note: incremental oncology approvals happen every year, so only something reported as a cure would count.

mentions.claim_text: He sees a shaking of the auto industry in Detroit naming GM, calling it a major shaking of Motor City and one more round of shaking, spoken alongside a garbled remark about blue election outcomes.
mentions.quote: I saw a shaking of the auto industry in Detroit
mentions.falsify_match: Mass layoffs, plant closures or a solvency crisis at a Detroit carmaker, GM in particular.
mentions.falsify_miss: Detroit carmakers post ordinary results with no major restructuring. Base rate note: auto layoff announcements are common, so only a GM-scale crisis counts.

mentions.claim_text: He sees Iran's leadership going down, and a reclusiveness coming over the Prince of Persia.
mentions.quote: I saw Iran's leadership going down
mentions.falsify_match: The removal, death or fall of Iran's senior leadership.
mentions.falsify_miss: Iran's leadership stays in place. The reclusiveness half is a spiritual claim with no public test.

mentions.claim_text: The Lord says he is giving the people of Iran a window and that the Prince of Persia will be reclusive for a season, which he says is short and guesses at three to five months or possibly a year.
mentions.quote: I'm giving the people of Iran a window
mentions.falsify_match: A measurable easing of religious repression in Iran within roughly a year.
mentions.falsify_miss: Repression in Iran continues or worsens through the next year. He explicitly refuses to define season, which caps this below a strong match either way.

mentions.claim_text: He sees a season of hot spots of revival breaking out in Iran, Pakistan and those areas.
mentions.quote: hot spots of fire of revival breaking out in Iran, Pakistan
mentions.falsify_match: Reported growth of Christian conversion or house churches in Iran and Pakistan during the period.
mentions.falsify_miss: No reported growth. Base rate note: claims of Iranian house-church growth are already a standing feature of mission reporting, so this is close to a safe bet.

mentions.claim_text: Revival will spring up in hot spots rather than everywhere, in Iran and with much persecution.
mentions.quote: It will just be spots of revival as you see it in Iran
mentions.falsify_match: Localised revival reports out of Iran accompanied by continued state persecution of converts.
mentions.falsify_miss: Hedged both ways: partial and patchy revival with persecution is the status quo, so this is unlikely to fail and should not score as a strong hit.

mentions.claim_text: He sees the Ayatollah, the man in the black outfit rather than the white one, being taken out and says he is done, along with much of Iran's upper leadership, who will be replaced by a group that is not so radicalised.
mentions.quote: I saw him uh being taken out. He's done
mentions.falsify_match: Iran's supreme leader removed, killed or displaced, and senior leadership replaced by a visibly less hardline group.
mentions.falsify_miss: The supreme leader remains in office and the leadership stays hardline. This one has a clean either-way test, unlike most in this passage.
